title: SENTINEL V0 rooted wire schema registry
description: Validate a complete public wire document at this root. Every document is discriminated by wire_type; command, event, and agent-result discriminators bind to closed typed branches. Cross-field artifact hash equality is enforced by the WP0 semantic validator, not JSON Schema.

Polygon.description: Closed local-schematic ring. First coordinate MUST equal last coordinate; implementation validates closure and non-self-intersection.
